topic.readerProblem: Translate Qwairy’s EUR plans, workspaces and model-weighted credits into a repeatable monitoring budget.
topic.connection: Directly supports an AEOeye buyer selecting capacity for multi-engine AI-search visibility tracking.

assessment: The final guide separates prompts from model-weighted credits, retains EUR currency and workspace limits, and makes clear that premium models reduce the number of affordable sweeps. It uses the current official product-site offer of 100 free credits and does not infer missing free-tier prompt or workspace limits.

sources.supports: Official plan prices, allowances, engine credit weights and annual offer.
Official product context and current 100-free-credit, no-card offer.

checks: Opened every named official source and compared the visible price, currency, billing basis and allowances with the final article.
Recomputed the worked example from the published inputs and checked that caveats remain adjacent to the arithmetic.
Read the final opening, plan table, limitations, internal links and all four FAQs for consistency and documentation-only disclosure.
Confirmed the article makes no paid-account, accuracy, output-quality or hands-on performance claim.
